title: droqen - The roguelike spirit without procedural generation
speaker: droqen
talk_title: The roguelike spirit without procedural generation
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

In this lighting talk droqen discusses a game he's worked on that adheres to almost all of the 'low value factors' of the Berlin Interpretation, and how he's become tired of procedural generation being the assumed backbone of what makes something rogue-like or rogue-like-like. He discusses the idea of making games that diverge from the Classic Roguelike in a different way than Spelunky did, and how there's so much more to the *feel* of a roguelike than just random levels!

Find him on Twitter: https://twitter.com/droqen
